"Expand all existing AETHERIA maps significantly. Make every region much larger, with wide landscapes, long paths, forests, open fields, mountains, dungeons and plenty of exploration space.

Design each map with enough space and spawn areas to eventually support 200–300 players simultaneously. Prepare the map architecture for future multiplayer. Do not simulate fake online players.

NPC RULES:

- The first two maps must contain the important NPCs, including merchants, blacksmiths, quest NPCs, storage and teleporters.
- All remaining maps must have no regular town NPCs, merchants or blacksmiths.
- Every other map must have only a teleporter that allows players to return to the main city.

Keep all existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items and gameplay systems. Preserve saved progress. Do not create a new project or remove existing features.

Optimize the larger maps for mobile performance. Test movement, map transitions and teleporters after the changes.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Expand all existing AETHERIA maps into much larger exploration regions, prepare the map architecture for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players, and retain the existing game and saved progress.

## Requirements
- Expand every existing region with varied landscapes, long paths, forests, fields, mountains, dungeons, and exploration space.
- First two maps must retain important town NPC roles, including merchants, blacksmiths, quest NPCs, storage, and teleporters.
- All later maps must have no regular town NPCs, merchants, or blacksmiths; each must have only a teleporter that returns players to the main city.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Optimize larger maps for mobile and test movement, map transitions, and teleporters.
- Deliver a playable build without asking clarifying questions; note reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing map generation, region definitions, NPC placement, travel logic, rendering, and save configuration.

### Active
- Implement the requested map expansion and NPC placement/travel changes.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all existing AETHERIA maps into much larger exploration regions while preserving the game and saved progress.
- Prepare map architecture for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players, optimize for mobile, and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes, long paths, forests, fields, mountains, dungeons, and exploration space.
- Keep important town NPC roles—including merchants, blacksmiths, quest NPCs, storage, and teleporters—on the first two maps.
- All later maps must have no regular town NPCs, merchants, or blacksmiths; only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players.
- Deliver a playable build without clarifying questions; note reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, and save configuration.
- Confirmed region sizes are currently 34–38 tiles, and `src/world.js` adds merchants and blacksmiths to every non-Greendale map.

### Active
- Implement larger regions and revise NPC placement and remote-map teleporter behavior.
- Review renderer and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `src/data.js` region dimensions and relevant coordinates while preserving region identity and content.
2. Update `src/world.js` to generate larger explorable terrain efficiently, retain town NPCs only on the first two maps, and place a city-return teleporter on every later map.
3. Update `src/game.js` so remote-map teleporters return players to Greendale while preserving dungeon and existing travel behavior.
4. Review and optimize ground rendering and minimap work for larger worlds.
5. Run the game, test movement, map transitions, and teleporters, and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, and minimap.
- `src/config.js`: Existing save key and gameplay configuration.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- No files have been modified; changes remain uncommitted.
- Existing teleporters on non-city maps currently have region-specific dialogue; return-to-city-only behavior is not implemented.
- `REGION_ORDER` includes eight maps; first two are Greendale and Ironcrag.
- Remote regions currently define quest keepers and teleporters in `NPCS`; quests depend on some quest-giver names, so preserve quest content while applying the requested NPC rules.

## Objective
- Expand all existing AETHERIA maps into much larger exploration regions while preserving the game and saved progress.
- Prepare the map architecture for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players, optimize for mobile, and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes, long paths, forests, fields, mountains, dungeons, and exploration space.
- Keep important town NPC roles—including merchants, blacksmiths, quest NPCs, storage, and teleporters—on the first two maps.
- Later maps must have no regular town NPCs, merchants, or blacksmiths; only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players.
- Deliver a playable build without clarifying questions; note reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed there are eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current region sizes are 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed `src/world.js` adds merchants and blacksmiths to every non-Greendale map, while remote regions have quest keepers and teleporters.

### Active
- Implement larger regions and revise NPC placement and remote-map teleporter behavior.
- Review renderer and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `src/data.js` region dimensions and relevant coordinates while preserving region identity and content.
2. Update `src/world.js` to generate larger explorable terrain efficiently, retain town NPCs only on the first two maps, and place a city-return teleporter on every later map.
3. Update `src/game.js` so remote-map teleporters return players to Greendale while preserving dungeon and existing travel behavior.
4. Review and optimize ground rendering and minimap work for larger worlds.
5. Run the game, test movement, map transitions, and teleporters, and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, and minimap.
- `src/config.js`: Existing save key and gameplay configuration.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- No files have been modified; changes remain uncommitted.
- Existing teleporters on non-city maps currently have region-specific dialogue; return-to-city-only behavior is not implemented.
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, so preserve quest content while applying the requested remote-map NPC rules.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all existing AETHERIA maps into much larger exploration regions while preserving the game and saved progress.
- Prepare the architecture for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players, optimize for mobile, and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes, long paths, forests, fields, mountains, dungeons, and exploration space.
- Keep important town NPC roles—including merchants, blacksmiths, quest NPCs, storage, and teleporters—on the first two maps.
- Later maps must have no regular town NPCs, merchants, or blacksmiths; only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players.
- Deliver a playable build without clarifying questions; note reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; existing map sizes are 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed `src/world.js` adds merchants and blacksmiths to every non-Greendale map, and remote maps currently have quest keepers and teleporters.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates as needed.
- Revise NPC placement so the first two maps retain town services and later maps contain only a Greendale-return teleporter, while preserving quest content.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `src/data.js` region dimensions and relevant coordinates.
2. Update `src/world.js` terrain generation and NPC placement for larger maps and the requested town/remote NPC rules.
3. Update `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting dungeon or existing travel behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger maps.
5. Run the game, test movement, region transitions, and teleporters, and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, and minimap.
- `src/config.js`: Existing save key and gameplay configuration.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- No files have been modified; changes remain uncommitted.
- Existing remote-map teleporters currently have region-specific dialogue, and no return-to-Greendale-only behavior exists.
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, so preserve quest content while applying the requested remote-map NPC rules.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players, optimize for mobile, and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes, long paths, forests, fields, mountains, dungeons, and exploration space.
- Keep town services—including merchants, blacksmiths, quest NPCs, storage, and teleporters—on the first two maps.
- Later maps must have no regular town NPCs, merchants, or blacksmiths; only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players.
- Deliver a playable build without clarifying questions; state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; existing map sizes are 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed `src/world.js` adds merchants and blacksmiths to every non-Greendale map; remote maps also have quest keepers and teleporters.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates as needed.
- Revise NPC placement to retain services on the first two maps and restrict later maps to a Greendale-return teleporter, while preserving quest content.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region dimensions and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger maps.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, and minimap.
- `src/config.js`: Existing save key and gameplay configuration.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- No files have been modified; changes remain uncommitted.
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, so preserve quest content while applying the requested remote-map NPC rules.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed remote maps currently receive quest keepers, teleporters, and additional merchants/blacksmiths.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Determine how to preserve quest content while removing regular NPCs from later maps.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger maps.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue and role actions.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- No files have been modified; changes remain uncommitted.
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.
- The game currently runs entirely locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed remote maps currently receive quest keepers, teleporters, and additional merchants/blacksmiths.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Determine how to preserve quest content while removing regular NPCs from later maps.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger maps.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue and role actions.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- No files have been modified; changes remain uncommitted.
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.
- The game currently runs entirely locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed remote maps currently receive quest keepers, teleporters, and additional merchants/blacksmiths.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Determine how to preserve quest content while removing regular NPCs from later maps.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger maps.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue and role actions.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- No files have been modified; changes remain uncommitted.
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.
- The game currently runs entirely locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed remote maps currently receive quest keepers, teleporters, and additional merchants/blacksmiths.
- No files modified; changes remain uncommitted.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Preserve quest access while restricting regular NPCs on later maps.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue and role actions.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.
- The game currently runs entirely locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed later regions currently have local quest keepers and teleporters, plus dynamically added merchants and blacksmiths.
- No files modified; changes remain uncommitted.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Preserve quest access while restricting regular NPCs on later maps.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue and role actions.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.
- The game runs entirely locally; no multiplayer server is present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed later regions currently have local quest keepers and teleporters, plus dynamically added merchants and blacksmiths.
- No files modified; changes remain uncommitted.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Preserve quest access while restricting regular NPCs on later maps.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue and role actions.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.
- The game runs entirely locally; no multiplayer server is present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; existing sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed later regions currently have local quest keepers and teleporters, plus dynamically added merchants and blacksmiths.
- No files modified; changes remain uncommitted.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Preserve quest access while restricting regular NPCs on later maps.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, visible-entity drawing, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue and role actions.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `Renderer.buildGround()` draws every tile, so expanded maps may affect rendering cost.
- The game runs entirely locally; no multiplayer server is present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; existing sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed later regions currently have local quest keepers and teleporters, plus dynamically added merchants and blacksmiths.
- Confirmed `Renderer.buildGround()` pre-renders every tile into a canvas sized from the region dimensions.
- Confirmed the repository has no `package.json`; no files have been modified.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Restrict regular NPCs on later maps while preserving quest access.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, and travel UI.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `src/game.js` `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, rather than always returning to Greendale.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed later regions have quest keepers and teleporters, plus dynamically added potion merchants and blacksmiths.
- Confirmed `Renderer.buildGround()` pre-renders every tile into a canvas sized from region dimensions.
- Confirmed the repository has no `package.json`; no files have been modified.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Restrict NPCs on later maps while preserving quest access.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, and travel UI.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `src/game.js` `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, rather than always returning to Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile; larger maps may increase its cost.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve existing graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed later regions have quest keepers and teleporters, plus dynamically added potion merchants and blacksmiths.
- Confirmed `Renderer.buildGround()` pre-renders every tile into a canvas sized from region dimensions.
- Confirmed the repository has no `package.json`; no files have been modified.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Restrict NPCs on later maps while preserving quest access.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, and travel UI.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `src/game.js` `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, rather than always returning to Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile; larger maps may increase its cost.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed `Renderer.buildGround()` pre-renders every tile into a canvas based on region dimensions.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed `Renderer.buildGround()` pre-renders every tile into a canvas based on region dimensions.
- Confirmed the repository has no `package.json`; no files have been modified.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Restrict NPCs on later maps while preserving quest access.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, and travel UI.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- `src/world.js` currently adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, alongside region NPCs.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `src/game.js` `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, rather than always returning to Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile; larger maps may increase its cost.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- (none)

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region definitions, procedural world generation, NPC placement, travel handling, rendering, save configuration, and map/minimap rendering.
- Confirmed eight regions in `REGION_ORDER`; current sizes range from 34–38 tiles.
- Confirmed `Renderer.buildGround()` pre-renders every tile into a canvas based on region dimensions; map ground uses `TW = 64`, `TH = 32`.
- Confirmed no implementation changes have been made.

### Active
- Plan expanded region dimensions and adjust spawn, village, lair, and feature coordinates.
- Restrict NPCs on later maps while preserving quest access.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded worlds.
- Test movement, region transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and relevant coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation and NPC placement in `src/world.js`.
3. Update travel handling in `src/game.js` so later-map teleporters return players to Greendale without disrupting existing travel or dungeon behavior.
4. Review ground rendering, visible-entity processing, and minimap performance for larger worlds.
5. Run the game and test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quest data.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, and travel UI.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER` is `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest content depends on remote quest-giver names, including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others; preserve quest access when applying the later-map NPC restriction.
- `src/world.js` currently adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, alongside region NPCs.
- NPC interactions emit the NPC object through `Events.emit('npc', target)`; travel actions are handled downstream.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, rather than always returning to Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile; larger maps may increase its cost.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region configuration, world generation, NPCs, quest data, travel, rendering, and minimap behavior.
- Confirmed there are eight regions, currently 34–38 tiles wide.
- Confirmed terrain is pre-rendered to a canvas and minimap redraw iterates over every tile.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust feature placement while keeping all coordinates and paths in bounds.
- Preserve quest access on later maps while removing town services there and adding a return-to-Greendale teleporter.
- Ensure “return to hub” from later regions and dungeons goes to Greendale.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded maps.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update sizes and coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js` and `src/game.js`.
3. Review rendering and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Run the game and test exploration, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and player movement.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, travel UI, and dungeon return action.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER`: `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest givers include Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others on later maps; preserve access to them.
- `src/world.js` currently adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region.
- NPC interactions emit `Events.emit('npc', target)`; UI routes NPC roles to actions.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, not Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops through all map tiles.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress; do not create a new project or remove existing features.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region configuration, world generation, NPCs, quest data, travel, rendering, and minimap behavior.
- Confirmed there are eight regions, currently 34–38 tiles wide; terrain is pre-rendered to a canvas and minimap redraw iterates over every tile.
- Confirmed later-region NPCs include quest givers and teleporters; `src/world.js` also adds Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust feature placement while keeping coordinates and paths in bounds.
- Preserve quest access on later maps, remove town services there, and provide return-to-Greendale teleporters.
- Update `returnToHub()` so later regions and dungeons return players to Greendale.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded maps.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update sizes and coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js` and `src/game.js`.
3. Review rendering and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Run the game and test exploration, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and `returnToHub()`.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, travel UI, and dungeon return action.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER`: `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest givers include Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others on later maps; preserve access to them.
- NPC interactions emit `Events.emit('npc', target)`; UI routes NPC roles to actions.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, not Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.
- No implementation changes have been made; the last observed `git status --short` output was empty.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region configuration, world generation, NPCs, quest data, travel, rendering, and minimap behavior.
- Confirmed there are eight regions, currently 34–38 tiles wide; terrain is pre-rendered to a canvas and minimap redraw iterates over every tile.
- Confirmed `src/world.js` adds Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust feature placement while keeping coordinates and paths in bounds.
- Preserve quest access on later maps, remove town services there, and provide return-to-Greendale teleporters.
- Update `returnToHub()` so later regions and dungeons return players to Greendale.
- Review rendering and minimap costs for expanded maps.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update sizes and coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js` and `src/game.js`.
3. Review rendering and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Run the game and test exploration, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and `returnToHub()`.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, travel UI, and dungeon return action.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER`: `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest givers include Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others on later maps; preserve access to them.
- NPC interactions emit `Events.emit('npc', target)`; UI routes NPC roles to actions.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns to the current region, or the dungeon’s region, not Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.
- No implementation changes have been made; the last observed `git status --short` output was empty.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region configuration, world generation, NPCs, quest access, travel behavior, renderer, minimap, and startup scripts.
- Confirmed the repository had no reported changes at the last status check.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust feature placement while keeping coordinates and paths in bounds.
- Preserve quest access on later maps, remove town services there, and provide return-to-Greendale teleporters.
- Update `returnToHub()` so later regions and dungeons return players to Greendale.
- Review rendering and minimap performance for expanded maps.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update sizes and coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js` and `src/game.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Run the game and test exploration, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and `returnToHub()`.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, travel UI, and dungeon return action.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER`: `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Region sizes are currently 34–38 tiles; spawn, village, and lair coordinates are near the center and upper-right edges.
- `src/world.js` adds Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region.
- Quest givers including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others are on later maps; preserve access to them.
- NPC interactions emit `Events.emit('npc', target)`; UI routes NPC roles to actions.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns players to their current region, or the dungeon’s region, not Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile; terrain is pre-rendered to a canvas.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region configuration, world generation, NPCs, quest access, travel behavior, renderer, minimap, and startup scripts.
- Confirmed the repository had no reported changes at the last status check.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust feature placement while keeping coordinates and paths in bounds.
- Preserve quest access on later maps, remove town services there, and provide return-to-Greendale teleporters.
- Update `returnToHub()` so later regions and dungeons return players to Greendale.
- Review rendering and minimap performance for expanded maps.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update sizes and coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js` and `src/game.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Run the game and test exploration, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and `returnToHub()`.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, travel UI, and dungeon return action.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER`: `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Region sizes are currently 34–38 tiles; spawn, village, and lair coordinates are near the center and upper-right edges.
- `src/world.js` adds Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region.
- Quest givers including Scout Kael, Scout Ivy, and others are on later maps; preserve access to them.
- NPC interactions emit `Events.emit('npc', target)`; UI routes NPC roles to actions.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns players to their current region, or the dungeon’s region, not Greendale.
- The minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile; terrain is pre-rendered to a canvas.
- The game runs locally; no multiplayer server is present.
- The latest inspection found Greendale-only services and teleporter NPCs in `src/data.js`; each later region currently has both a quest giver and teleporter NPC. `src/ui.js` exposes region travel and a dungeon return action.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region configuration, world generation, NPCs, quest access, travel behavior, renderer, minimap, and startup scripts.
- Confirmed world sizes are currently 34–38 tiles, with village and lair coordinates positioned toward map centers and edges.
- Confirmed each later region has quest givers and teleporter NPCs; `src/world.js` also adds Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust feature placement while keeping coordinates and paths in bounds.
- Preserve quest access on later maps, remove town services there, and provide return-to-Greendale teleporters.
- Update `returnToHub()` so later regions and dungeons return players to Greendale.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js` and `src/game.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Run the game and test exploration, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and `returnToHub()`.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, travel UI, and dungeon return action.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER`: `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Quest givers on later maps must remain accessible; teleporters currently open the world map.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns players to their current region or the dungeon’s region, not Greendale.
- Terrain is pre-rendered to a canvas; the minimap redraws on a timer and loops over every map tile.
- No multiplayer server is present.

## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region into larger exploration maps while preserving the existing game and saved progress.
- Prepare the game for future 200–300-player multiplayer without fake players; optimize for mobile and test movement, transitions, and teleporters.

## Requirements
- Expand every region with varied landscapes and room to explore.
- Keep town services on the first two maps; later maps should have only a teleporter returning players to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; deliver a playable build without clarifying questions and state reasonable assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or changes have been made.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected region configuration, world generation, NPCs, quest access, travel behavior, renderer, minimap, and startup scripts.
- Confirmed world sizes are currently 34–38 tiles, with village and lair coordinates positioned toward map centers and edges.
- Confirmed non-Greendale regions have quest givers and teleporters; `src/world.js` also adds Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region.
- Confirmed terrain is pre-rendered to a canvas, the minimap loops through every map tile, and the worktree was clean when checked.

### Active
- Expand region dimensions and adjust feature placement while keeping coordinates and paths in bounds.
- Preserve quest access on later maps, remove town services there, and provide return-to-Greendale teleporters.
- Update `returnToHub()` so later regions and dungeons return players to Greendale.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test movement, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Update region sizes and coordinates in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js` and `src/game.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Run the game and test exploration, transitions, teleporters, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, spawn/village/lair coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, collision, and world population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, and `returnToHub()`.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/ui.js`: NPC dialogue, role actions, travel UI, and dungeon return action.
- `src/state.js`: Save and progress persistence.

## Important Context
- `REGION_ORDER`: `greendale`, `ironcrag`, `venomwood`, `mistgrave`, `frostpeak`, `sunscorch`, `ashen`, `tower`.
- Later-region quest givers must remain accessible; teleporters currently open the world map.
- `returnToHub()` currently returns players to their current region or the dungeon’s region, not Greendale.
- No multiplayer server is present.
