## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions to provide more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends the player to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` blocks travel from regions after Ironcrag to destinations other than Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned in `src/data.js`.

### Active
- Expand the remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/game.js` and `src/ui.js` had pre-existing modifications. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Landmark coordinates, ponds, village/lair layouts use fixed offsets; resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; minimap updates periodically. Both costs grow with map size.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions to provide more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends the player to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` blocks travel from regions after Ironcrag to destinations other than Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned in `src/data.js`.

### Active
- Expand the remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/game.js` and `src/ui.js` had pre-existing modifications. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Landmark coordinates, ponds, village/lair layouts use fixed offsets; resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. Minimap updates periodically. These costs grow with map size.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends the player to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned in `src/data.js`.

### Active
- Expand the remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/game.js` and `src/ui.js` had pre-existing modifications. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Landmark coordinates, ponds, village/lair layouts use fixed offsets; resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. Minimap updates periodically. These costs grow with map size.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions for more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends the player to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation and renderer scaling costs; no changes made in this review.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/game.js` and `src/ui.js` had pre-existing modifications. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Landmark coordinates, ponds, village/lair layouts use fixed offsets; resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. Minimap updates periodically. These costs grow with map size.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends the player to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation and renderer scaling costs; no changes made in this review.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Landmark coordinates, ponds, village/lair layouts use fixed offsets; resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. Minimap updates periodically. These costs grow with map size.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand all AETHERIA regions to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation, renderer ground pre-rendering, and minimap costs; no performance changes made.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Landmark coordinates, ponds, village/lair layouts use fixed offsets; resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. Minimap updates periodically. These costs grow with map size.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation, ground pre-rendering, and minimap costs; no performance changes made.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Landmark coordinates, ponds, village/lair layouts use fixed offsets; resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. Minimap updates periodically. These costs grow with map size.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- `NPCS` defines quest keepers and teleporters in all regions, including later regions; regional teleporter NPCs currently open the general map UI.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation, ground pre-rendering, minimap costs, and relevant region-generation logic; no performance changes made.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation, ground pre-rendering, minimap costs, and relevant region-generation logic; no performance changes made.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Water-pond coordinates are fixed per region; path generation relies on village/spawn/lair and map edges. Village and lair layouts use fixed offsets.
- Resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18 regardless of map size.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. These costs grow with map size. Minimap updates periodically.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- `NPCS` defines quest keepers and teleporters in all regions, including later regions; regional teleporter NPCs currently open the general map UI.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation, ground pre-rendering, minimap costs, and relevant region-generation logic; no performance changes made.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- Remaining regions are 34–38 tiles across; only Greendale is currently size 56.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with the service-location requirement.
- Water-pond coordinates are fixed per region; path generation relies on village/spawn/lair and map edges. Village and lair layouts use fixed offsets.
- Resource nodes remain at 8, normal enemies at 15, and roadside details at 18 regardless of map size.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. These costs grow with map size. Minimap updates periodically.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- `NPCS` defines quest keepers and teleporters in all regions, including later regions; regional teleporter NPCs currently open the general map UI.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Remaining region sizes and landmark positions are undecided.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale’s dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Reviewed world generation, ground pre-rendering, minimap costs, and relevant region-generation logic; no performance changes made.
- Confirmed current sizes for other regions are 34–38 tiles, and village/lair construction uses fixed offsets.

### Active
- Expand remaining regions and reposition landmarks, water, paths, and content.
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Choose expanded dimensions and reposition landmarks for all regions in `src/data.js`.
2. Adjust terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior in `src/world.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js`.
3. Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
4. Test world traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmarks, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Teleport pricing and persistent character state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, and `src/ui.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these changes.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions now have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates; see `src/data.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- `Game.travelTo()` restricts travel from regions after Ironcrag to Greendale.
- `returnToHub()` and death respawn send players in later regions to Greendale.
- `panelMap()` shows only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hides dungeon listings there.
- Greendale dimensions and landmark coordinates were expanded/repositioned.
- Increased Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch, Ashen, and Tower map sizes and repositioned landmarks.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.

### Active
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Adjust fixed water ponds and review terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior for expanded maps.
- Review renderer and minimap performance for larger worlds.
- Test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile performance.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `src/world.js` to remove later-region provisioner and smith NPCs and revise water feature placement for expanded maps.
2. Check safe traversal and content distribution across all expanded maps; adjust generation density as appropriate.
3. Review renderer/minimap performance and test region travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, camera, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Teleport pricing and persistent character state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these changes.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with service-location requirements.
- Regional teleporter NPCs currently open the general map UI.
- Water-pond coordinates remain at their original locations, which may no longer fit the relocated landmarks.
- Village and lair layouts use fixed offsets; current expanded landmarks have room for these layouts.
- Resource nodes now scale as `Math.max(8, Math.round(world.size * 0.28))`; normal enemies remain 15 and roadside details remain 18.
- Renderer pre-renders all ground tiles; visible entity candidates are filtered after iterating each collection, then sorted. Minimap updates periodically.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more varied exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated region sizes and landmark coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale in `Game.travelTo()`; return and death behavior also route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.

### Active
- Remove Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs from regions after Ironcrag while retaining quest keepers and Greendale-return teleporters.
- Adjust fixed water pond placement for expanded maps and review terrain generation, NPC placement, content density, and teleporter behavior.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and test traversal, transitions, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `src/world.js` to remove later-region provisioner and smith NPCs and revise pond placement for expanded maps.
2. Check safe traversal and content distribution across expanded maps; adjust generation density if needed.
3. Review performance and test region travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain generation, pond placement, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Teleport pricing and persistent character state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- `buildWorld()` still adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, conflicting with service-location requirements.
- Regional teleporter NPCs currently open the general map UI; their return-only behavior has not been specifically updated.
- Water-pond coordinates remain at original locations; expanded maps may make them poorly placed relative to landmarks.
- Village and lair layouts use fixed offsets; the current expanded landmarks appear to leave room for these layouts.
- Resource nodes scale as `Math.max(8, Math.round(world.size * 0.28))`; open-world enemies remain 15 and roadside details remain 18.
- Renderer pre-renders ground tiles, iterates entity collections before filtering visible candidates, then sorts drawables; minimap updates periodically. Larger-world performance has not been tested.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`.
- No root `package.json` was found; no tests or runtime verification have been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated region sizes and landmark coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale in `Game.travelTo()`; return and death behavior also route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.

### Active
- Remove generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs from regions after Ironcrag, while retaining those services in Ironcrag and retaining later-region quest keepers and return teleporters.
- Review pond placement and terrain/content distribution on expanded maps, including safe traversal.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `src/world.js` to keep generated provisioner and smith NPCs in Ironcrag but remove them from regions after Ironcrag; revise pond placement if needed.
2. Check safe traversal and content distribution across expanded maps; adjust generation density if needed.
3. Review performance and test region travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Teleport pricing and persistent character state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- `buildWorld()` currently adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, including Ironcrag; the service-location requirement means they should remain in Ironcrag but not later regions.
- Later-region teleporter NPCs are placed from `NPCS`; interacting with any NPC emits the `npc` event, so confirm their panels/actions provide only Greendale return travel.
- Pond coordinates remain fixed in `src/world.js`: Greendale `[26,7]`, Ironcrag `[7,26]`, Venomwood `[27,6]`, Mistgrave `[7,27]`, Frostpeak `[27,7]`, Sunscorch `[7,28]`, Ashen `[28,7]`, Tower `[7,7]`.
- Resource nodes scale as `Math.max(8, Math.round(world.size * 0.28))`; open-world enemies remain 15 and roadside details remain 18.
- Renderer iterates entity collections before filtering visible candidates, sorts drawables, and updates the minimap periodically; larger-world performance has not been tested.
- Saved region and coordinates persist in `state.char.region`, `state.char.x`, and `state.char.y`; no runtime or test verification has been performed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.

### Active
- Remove generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs from regions after Ironcrag, while retaining those services in Ironcrag and retaining later-region quest keepers and return teleporters.
- Review pond placement and terrain/content distribution on expanded maps, including safe traversal.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `src/world.js` to keep generated provisioner and smith NPCs in Ironcrag but remove them from regions after Ironcrag; revise pond placement if needed.
2. Check safe traversal and content distribution across expanded maps; adjust generation density if needed.
3. Review performance and test region travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Teleport pricing and persistent character state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- `buildWorld()` currently adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, including Ironcrag; they should remain in Ironcrag but not later regions.
- Later-region teleporter NPCs are placed from `NPCS`; interacting with any NPC emits the `npc` event, so confirm their panels/actions provide only Greendale return travel.
- Pond coordinates remain fixed in `src/world.js`: Greendale `[26,7]`, Ironcrag `[7,26]`, Venomwood `[27,6]`, Mistgrave `[7,27]`, Frostpeak `[27,7]`, Sunscorch `[7,28]`, Ashen `[28,7]`, Tower `[7,7]`.
- Resource nodes scale as `Math.max(8, Math.round(world.size * 0.28))`; open-world enemies remain 15 and roadside details remain 18.
- Renderer iterates entity collections before filtering visible candidates, sorts drawables, and updates the minimap periodically; larger-world performance has not been tested.
- No runtime or test verification has been performed; the repository has no `package.json` or test files found.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.

### Active
- Remove generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs from regions after Ironcrag, while retaining those services in Ironcrag and retaining later-region quest keepers and return teleporters.
- Review pond placement and terrain/content distribution on expanded maps, including safe traversal.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

### Blocked
- Runtime world-generation check was attempted but not run: `node --experimental-default-type=module` failed with `node: bad option: --experimental-default-type=module`.

## Next Move
1. Update `src/world.js` to keep generated provisioner and smith NPCs in Ironcrag but remove them from regions after Ironcrag; revise pond placement if needed.
2. Check safe traversal and content distribution across expanded maps; adjust generation density if needed.
3. Review performance and test region travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play using an available runtime approach.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, NPC definitions, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, and enemy population.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Teleport pricing and persistent character state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- `buildWorld()` currently adds a Camp Provisioner and Field Smith to every non-Greendale region, including Ironcrag; they should remain in Ironcrag but not later regions.
- Later-region teleporter NPCs are placed from `NPCS`; interacting with any NPC emits the `npc` event, so confirm their panels/actions provide only Greendale return travel.
- Pond coordinates remain fixed in `src/world.js`: Greendale `[26,7]`, Ironcrag `[7,26]`, Venomwood `[27,6]`, Mistgrave `[7,27]`, Frostpeak `[27,7]`, Sunscorch `[7,28]`, Ashen `[28,7]`, Tower `[7,7]`.
- Resource nodes scale as `Math.max(8, Math.round(world.size * 0.28))`; open-world enemies remain 15 and roadside details remain 18.
- Renderer iterates entity collections before filtering visible candidates, sorts drawables, and updates the minimap periodically; larger-world performance has not been tested.
- No runtime or test verification has been completed; no test files were found.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.
- Cleared stale tile blocking when terrain is changed from water/void to another type in `src/world.js`.

### Active
- Remove generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs from regions after Ironcrag while retaining Ironcrag services and later-region quest keepers and return teleporters.
- Review pond placement and terrain/content distribution on expanded maps, including safe traversal.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

### Blocked
- Tower of Eternity has only 3 reachable tiles in a runtime connectivity check; its `ground: 'void'` terrain blocks nearly the entire region.
- The initial runtime check command failed with `node: bad option: --experimental-default-type=module`; a temporary ESM copy enabled later checks.

## Next Move
1. Fix Tower of Eternity terrain generation so its traversable area is connected and supports exploration, then rerun connectivity checks for all regions.
2. Update `src/world.js` to keep generated provisioner and smith NPCs in Ironcrag but remove them from later regions.
3. Check safe traversal, landmark access, content distribution, and performance; test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, terrain configuration, NPCs, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, enemy population, collision.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- Runtime report for every region: spawn was unblocked; Greendale through Ashen had thousands of reachable tiles, but Tower had only 3 of 3364 due to void tiles.
- The connectivity check ran from `/tmp/opencode/aetheria` using copied JS files and a temporary `package.json` with `{"type":"module"}`; subsequent source edits have not been recopied or retested.
- Resource nodes scale as `Math.max(8, Math.round(world.size * 0.28))`; open-world enemies remain 15 and roadside details remain 18.
- Renderer iterates entity collections before filtering visible candidates, sorts drawables, and updates the minimap periodically; larger-world performance has not been tested.
- No test files were found.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Tower of Eternity uses traversable `ground1` terrain with void tiles retained at its map edges.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.
- Cleared stale tile blocking when terrain changes from water/void to another type in `src/world.js`.
- Kept generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs in Ironcrag only; later regions retain their configured quest keepers and teleporters.
- Fixed Tower terrain connectivity; runtime checks found the spawn unblocked and thousands of reachable tiles in every region.

### Active
- Review pond placement, terrain/content distribution, and safe traversal on expanded maps.
- Test landmark access, travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, renderer/minimap performance, and mobile play.

### Blocked
- Runtime connectivity checks did not mark the exact configured lair coordinate reachable in any region; investigate whether this reflects landmark props or actual lair access.

## Next Move
1. Inspect lair access and connectivity around each lair, then check traversal and content distribution.
2. Test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, and mobile play.
3. Review renderer/minimap performance on expanded maps and report the completed changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, terrain configuration, NPCs, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, enemy population, collision.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- Runtime report after the latest terrain/NPC changes: each region had an unblocked spawn and thousands of reachable tiles; later regions had only Quest Keeper and Teleporter roles, while Ironcrag retained its services.
- The connectivity check was run from `/tmp/opencode/aetheria` using copied JS files and a temporary ESM `package.json`; latest source files were recopied before the check.
- Resource nodes scale as `Math.max(8, Math.round(world.size * 0.28))`; open-world enemies remain 15 and roadside details remain 18.
- Renderer iterates entity collections before filtering visible candidates, sorts drawables, and updates the minimap periodically; expanded-world performance has not been tested.
- No test files were found.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Tower of Eternity uses traversable `ground1` terrain with void tiles retained at its map edges.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.
- Cleared stale tile blocking when terrain changes from water/void to another type in `src/world.js`.
- Kept generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs in Ironcrag only; later regions retain their configured quest keepers and teleporters.
- Fixed Tower terrain connectivity; runtime checks found the spawn unblocked and thousands of reachable tiles in every region.
- Investigated lair reachability: the lair center is blocked by its landmark props, but all regions have 40–43 reachable tiles within 4 units and nearest walkable tile is about 1.58 units away.

### Active
- Review pond placement and terrain/content distribution, plus safe traversal on expanded maps.
- Test landmark/boss access, travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, renderer/minimap performance, and mobile play.

### Blocked
- Actual dungeon spawn/boss access has not been validated; the recent dungeon probe used `dungeonId: 'test'`, which is not a configured dungeon ID.

## Next Move
1. Validate real dungeon entry and boss reachability using configured IDs from `DUNGEONS`.
2. Test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, saved progress, pond placement, and traversal.
3. Review renderer/minimap performance and mobile play, then report completed changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, terrain configuration, NPCs, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, enemy population, collision.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- Runtime connectivity checks found each region’s spawn and village reachable, with 2,162–3,578 reachable tiles.
- Renderer creates and rasterizes a ground canvas per world; expanded-world performance and mobile play have not been tested.
- No test files were found.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Tower of Eternity uses traversable `ground1` terrain with void tiles retained at its map edges.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.
- Cleared stale tile blocking when terrain changes from water/void to another type in `src/world.js`.
- Kept generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs in Ironcrag only; later regions retain their configured quest keepers and teleporters.
- Fixed Tower terrain connectivity.
- Validated all six configured dungeons (`forge`, `crypt`, `brood`, `sepulcher`, `sun_king`, `eternal_spire`): each had an unblocked spawn and boss, with spawn-to-boss distance about 7.7–8.1 units.
- Runtime checks found each region’s spawn unblocked and reachable areas of 2,162–3,578 tiles; ponds occupy 24–44 tiles per region.

### Active
- Test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, and saved progress.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and mobile play.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test travel restrictions, return/death routing, and teleporters across Greendale, Ironcrag, later regions, and dungeons.
2. Verify existing saved progress remains intact after loading and region transitions.
3. Review pond placement and traversal, then assess renderer/minimap performance and mobile play.
4. Report completed changes, test results, and assumptions; explicitly note that no fake players were added.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, terrain configuration, NPCs, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, enemy population, collision.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Local save/load behavior and character progress.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- Runtime validation scripts used temporary copies in `/tmp/opencode/aetheria`; those copies are not the project source.
- The dungeon probe now uses the configured dungeon IDs and found unblocked spawns and bosses.
- No test files were found; browser/mobile performance and saved-progress behavior remain unverified.

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser

  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element

  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref

  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:

  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:

  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Tower of Eternity uses traversable `ground1` terrain with void tiles retained at its map edges.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.
- Cleared stale tile blocking when terrain changes from water/void to another type in `src/world.js`.
- Kept generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs in Ironcrag only; later regions retain their configured quest keepers and teleporters.
- Fixed Tower terrain connectivity.
- Validated all six configured dungeons (`forge`, `crypt`, `brood`, `sepulcher`, `sun_king`, `eternal_spire`): each had an unblocked spawn and boss, with spawn-to-boss distance about 7.7–8.1 units.
- Runtime checks found each region’s spawn unblocked and reachable areas of 2,162–3,578 tiles; ponds occupy 24–44 tiles per region.
- `git diff --check` completed without reported whitespace errors.

### Active
- Test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, and saved progress.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and mobile play.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test travel restrictions, return/death routing, and teleporters across Greendale, Ironcrag, later regions, and dungeons.
2. Verify existing saved progress remains intact after loading and region transitions.
3. Review pond placement and traversal, then assess renderer/minimap performance and mobile play.
4. Report completed changes, test results, and assumptions; explicitly note that no fake players were added.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, terrain configuration, NPCs, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, enemy population, collision.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Local save/load behavior and character progress.
- `/tmp/opencode/aetheria`: Temporary project copy used for runtime validation; not the source project.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- A runtime probe ran against the temporary copy at `/tmp/opencode/aetheria`; its displayed output was truncated, while the earlier checkpoint records the broader validation results.
- Browser/mobile performance and saved-progress behavior remain unverified.
