## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Tower of Eternity uses traversable `ground1` terrain with void tiles retained at its map edges.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.
- Cleared stale tile blocking when terrain changes from water/void to another type in `src/world.js`.
- Kept generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs in Ironcrag only; later regions retain configured quest keepers and teleporters.
- Fixed Tower terrain connectivity.
- Validated all six configured dungeons (`forge`, `crypt`, `brood`, `sepulcher`, `sun_king`, `eternal_spire`): each had an unblocked spawn and boss, with spawn-to-boss distance about 7.7–8.1 units.
- Runtime checks found each region’s spawn unblocked and reachable areas of 2,162–3,578 tiles; ponds occupy 24–44 tiles per region.
- `git diff --check` completed without reported whitespace errors.

### Active
- Test travel, death/return behavior, teleporters, and saved progress.
- Review renderer/minimap performance and mobile play.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test travel restrictions, return/death routing, and teleporters across Greendale, Ironcrag, later regions, and dungeons.
2. Verify existing saved progress remains intact after loading and region transitions.
3. Review pond placement and assess renderer/minimap performance and mobile play.
4. Report completed changes, test results, and assumptions; explicitly note that no fake players were added.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, terrain configuration, NPCs, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, enemy population, collision.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Local save/load behavior and character progress.
- `src/main.js`: Game initialization and continue-save flow.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.

- `playwright-cli` is available, but no browser test was run.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Expand every AETHERIA region to offer more room and variety for exploration while preserving gameplay and saved progress.
- Keep the game mobile-playable and optimized, with future multiplayer capacity but no fake players.

## Requirements
- Expand every region and provide more room to explore.
- Keep town services in Greendale and Ironcrag; later regions retain quest access and have only a teleporter returning to Greendale.
- Preserve graphics, characters, classes, quests, items, gameplay systems, and saved progress.
- Do not simulate fake online players; make reasonable assumptions without clarifying questions and state them at completion.

## Decisions
- From regions after Ironcrag, leyline travel is restricted to Greendale.
- Returning from later regions and dying there sends players to Greendale.
- Greendale is size 56, with spawn `[28, 33]`, village `[28, 26]`, and lair `[46, 44]`.
- Other expanded regions have larger sizes and repositioned spawn, village, and lair coordinates in `src/data.js`.
- Tower of Eternity uses traversable `ground1` terrain with void tiles retained at its map edges.

## Work State
### Completed
- Expanded region sizes and repositioned landmarks in `src/data.js`.
- Restricted later-region travel to Greendale; return and death behavior route players there.
- Updated the map UI to show only Greendale as the travel destination from later regions and hide dungeon listings.
- Increased resource-node count proportionally to map size, with a minimum of 8.
- Cleared stale tile blocking when terrain changes from water/void to another type in `src/world.js`.
- Kept generated Camp Provisioner and Field Smith NPCs in Ironcrag only; later regions retain configured quest keepers and teleporters.
- Fixed Tower terrain connectivity.
- Validated all six configured dungeons (`forge`, `crypt`, `brood`, `sepulcher`, `sun_king`, `eternal_spire`): each had an unblocked spawn and boss, with spawn-to-boss distance about 7.7–8.1 units.
- Runtime probes found each region’s spawn unblocked and reachable areas of 2,162–3,578 tiles; ponds occupy 24–44 tiles per region.
- Mobile browser checks at 390×844 showed Greendale starts at size 56/spawn `[28,33]`; Ironcrag size 52 has Quest Keeper, Teleporter, Potion Merchant, and Blacksmith.
- Verified Ironcrag `returnToHub()` returns to Ironcrag after the transition completes.
- Verified later-region map shows only Greendale, hides dungeons, and explains that quest keepers remain available.
- Verified later regions retain Quest Keeper and Teleporter NPCs with no service NPCs in Venomwood.
- Verified travel onward from Venomwood is rejected without spending gold; death there returns to Greendale.
- Verified local save/load preserves region coordinates, gold, level, XP, and inventory item data.
- Browser runtime checks reported no JavaScript errors; a 390×844 browser animation probe measured ~60 FPS (p95 frame interval 16.8 ms).
- `git diff --check` passes.

### Active
- Retest travel through every later region; the latest automated loop’s first travel into Venomwood succeeded, but subsequent attempts to advance were rejected because the return-to-hub restriction correctly applied.
- Review mobile gameplay beyond viewport and frame-rate smoke probes; no full interaction/play session has been completed.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` could not start because its expected Chromium installation was absent; direct Playwright testing succeeded using `/opt/google/chrome/google-chrome`.

## Next Move
1. Continue region-by-region travel checks by returning to Greendale between later-region destinations; verify NPC quest access and return-only teleporter behavior.
2. Perform a brief mobile interaction/playability check beyond startup, then recheck `git status` and `git diff --check`.
3. Summarize changes, validation limits, and explicitly note that no fake players were added.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data.js`: Region sizes, landmark coordinates, terrain configuration, NPCs, dungeons, and quests.
- `src/world.js`: Terrain and pond generation, NPC placement, scenery, resource nodes, enemy population, collision.
- `src/game.js`: Region transitions, teleportation, return behavior, death respawn, and saved coordinates.
- `src/ui.js`: World-map travel UI, NPC services, and region progress display.
- `src/renderer.js`: Ground rendering, entity rendering, and minimap.
- `src/state.js`: Local save/load behavior and character progress.
- `src/main.js`: Game initialization and continue-save flow.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js` are modified. Preserve and inspect these edits.
- Browser testing used a temporary character and isolated browser context; it did not alter repository files.
- `returnToHub()` is asynchronous during region transitions; wait until `game.transitioning` is false before subsequent travel checks.

Expanded all eight regions and completed the travel and mobile smoke checks.

- **World sizes:** Greendale 56, Ironcrag 52, Venomwood 56, Mistgrave 58, Frostpeak 60, Sunscorch 62, Ashen 64, and Tower of Eternity 58.
- **Travel and services:** Later-region leylines return to Greendale; onward travel is blocked. Ironcrag retains its services, while later regions have quest keepers and return teleporters only. Quest keepers successfully opened the quest log in every tested region.
- **Mobile check:** At 390×844, the joystick and action controls fit within the viewport, and joystick input moved the character. Browser checks reported no JavaScript errors.
- **Preservation checks:** Prior probes confirmed saved character progress is retained and death in a later region returns the player to Greendale. `git diff --check` passes.

The changes are in `src/data.js`, `src/game.js`, `src/ui.js`, and `src/world.js`. Testing was a headless-browser smoke check, not a full playthrough on a physical phone. **No fake online players were added.**
